title: Aina za nomino (Theme 2: Lishe bora)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 7 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child names a group with its group noun (kikosi, jeshi, bunda) and an idea with an abstract noun (afya, usafi), and agrees the verb with the group noun.
steps: Agree the verb with the head noun.
contexts: healthy eating (lishe bora): a basket of fruit

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ni nomino ipi ni ya makundi?" Kwa nini "mwanafunzi" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Nomino ya makundi hutaja kundi la viumbe au vitu, kama kikosi.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ni nomino ipi ni ya dhahania?" Kwa nini "meza" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Nomino ya dhahania haishikiki, kama upendo.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Neno jeshi ni nomino ya aina gani?" Kwa nini "dhahania" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Jeshi ni kundi la askari, kwa hiyo ni nomino ya makundi.

misconceptions.ask: Nomino kuu ni ipi, askari au jeshi?
misconceptions.repair: Kitenzi hupatana na nomino ya kundi: jeshi limefika.

checks.question: Ni nomino ya dhahania ipi: chakula, lishe, kikapu?
